rationale: The agent followed policy throughout. It verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before proceeding. It retrieved the correct order details and asked for explicit confirmation stating the items to be returned. When the user clarified they wanted the robotic vacuum (not the canister), the agent proceeded accordingly and only then executed the return via the tool. The tool response confirms the correct item IDs were returned and the status updated to return requested. The agent provided accurate refund totals based on tool data, correctly declined the 3-day guarantee while giving a typical processing window, and then accurately calculated the total paid for the remaining items, matching the order total minus the refund. No unsupported claims, no changes without confirmation, and actions were confined to the authenticated user’s account.
